messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> #eng-oncall
Severity: P2
Symptom: spike of 502/503 errors from eu-west canary subset after rolling v1.7.3 build with new compile optimization
Alert: https://alerts.internal/alert/1767809998

Maya: seeing 502/503 spike on canaries, error rate ~10-12% over last 90s. Looking into pod health.

Maya: `kubectl get pods -n model-serving -l canary=true` -> 12 pods, 3 in CrashLoopBackOff, rest Ready.

Jordan: @Maya adding myself to shadow. If you want to hand off in a few mins I can take primary. Can you grab runtime logs from one of the failing pods?

Maya: paste logs from model-canary-07 runtime container:
```
2026-03-15T21:03:11Z ERROR runtime: kernel selector picked quant_kernel_v2 -> incompatible op DynamicKVFetch
2026-03-15T21:03:11Z WARN  runtime: upstream proxy returned 502
2026-03-15T21:03:12Z ERROR memory: reserve failed on KV prefetch, OOM attempt
```

Samir: that looks like a kernel/quant profile mismatch. Yesterday's graph-reorder optimization may have changed op ordering; kernel matrix might not cover new ordering.

Samir: I'm going to flip the release flag to stop routing traffic to v1.7.3 canaries: `POST /api/feature-flags/flip {\"flag\":\"release_v1_7_3\",\"state\":\"off\"}`

Samir: flip executed -> console shows `release_v1_7_3` OFF :white_check_mark: (https://console.internal/flags/release_v1_7_3)

DeployBot: Rollback triggered by Samir. Rollback job rb-176780-01 started. Reverting canary requests to stable model variant.

Emily: Metrics: canary traffic falls to 0 within 30s. eu-west error rate drops from 9.9% -> 0.7% over next 3 minutes.

Maya: confirming: 502s subsided after flag flip. CrashLoop pods still restarting but not returning 502s for new requests. Archiving logs to s3.

Maya: customer impact summary: region eu-west impacted ~1.0k rps for ~7 minutes (21:02-21:09 UTC). Affected customers: AcmeAds (retry burden), BetaSearch (increased latency, retries). No persisted data loss. Support notified.

Jordan: Taking primary oncall handoff from @Maya. Handoff notes in thread.

Maya: Handoff notes for Jordan:
- logs archived: s3://redwood-incidents/1767809998/logs.tar.gz
- saw mixed compiled artifact versions across canary hosts (v1.4.2 and v1.5.0 kernels in rotation)
- repro: long KV prefix fetch triggers kernel selector to choose quant_kernel_v2 which is incompatible with DynamicKVFetch ordering after graph-reorder change
- tentative cause: new compile optimization + quant profile mismatch -> kernel selection failure

Jordan: I'll validate rollback completion across eu-west and kick off INC ticket. Linking eng-runtime + eng-ml for hotfix.

IncidentBot: Status update: Mitigated -> Traffic routed away from v1.7.3 canary subset; monitoring for 15m to ensure stability.

Emily: SLO impact: eu-west had a transient breach (7m window) — computing exact minutes and drafting customer note.

Samir: Action items:
- roll back graph-reorder compile change or patch kernel-selector to guard against op-order mismatches (owner: eng-runtime)
- add pre-deploy canary check verifying kernel/quant compatibility matrix (owner: eng-ml / eng-runtime)
- postmortem + RCA; assign owners and timeline
Ticket: INC-2026-1767809998

Jordan: I'll schedule the hotfix rollout and coordinate verification. Leaving thread open until PR lands and passes canary.

Support: initial outbound sent to top affected customers, offering post-incident summary. No escalations currently.

DeployBot: Rollback job rb-176780-01 completed at 2026-03-15T21:18:12Z

Jordan: Closing primary pager; monitoring window in progress. Will update when hotfix PR merges and canary re-rollout is safe. Thanks everyone for the quick flip.
